records.place_identity_and_access: The Sava corridor in Ljubljana is broad. A 2016 dedicated gay guide specifies a naturist/cruising zone on the left bank by Črnuče, but newer local journalism in December 2025 and April 2026 visited the municipal Sava Beach in Ježica/Črnuče area and saw abandoned condoms/traces of intimate meetings; journalists did not establish they came from gay male cruising, nor is it proven the same exact source pin. Country directory displays a dated 7 May 2026 platform check-in to the Sava entry (unverified physical visit). Avoid presenting any of this as a confirmed gay-male encounter in 2026; strong lead for next deeper inspection.
